zh-CN.app.name: FilamentManager
zh-CN.app.subtitle: 本地打印机运维
zh-CN.overview.title: 打印机总览
zh-CN.overview.subtitle: 优先显示设备连接、打印状态、异常、温度和数据覆盖率；从这里进入单台设备大屏、趋势和资产页。
zh-CN.overview.noPrintersHint: 先添加或扫描局域网内的 Bambu 打印机。
zh-CN.overview.search: 搜索名称、主机、机型或状态
zh-CN.dashboard.cameraStreamLanLiveviewRequire: 请在打印机上开启局域网实时预览
zh-CN.metrics.temperatureSubtitle: 喷嘴、热床和腔体温度随时间变化
zh-CN.metrics.fanSubtitle: 各风扇转速百分比变化
zh-CN.metrics.wifiSubtitle: 信号强度 dBm，越接近 0 代表越强
zh-CN.metrics.amsSubtitle: AMS 内部温度与湿度采样
zh-CN.metrics.progressSubtitle: 进度百分比和剩余时间趋势
zh-CN.storage.previewSubtitle: 共 {count} 个视频，预览停在末帧便于查看成品模型。
zh-CN.storage.pageInfo: 第 {page} / {total} 页 · 共 {count} 个
zh-CN.maintenance.subtitle: 按打印小时跟踪本地维护项，优先处理到期与即将到期项目。
zh-CN.maintenance.worklistSubtitle: 到期项目靠前展示，标记已维护只写入本地历史。
zh-CN.inventory.searchSku: 搜索 SKU、品牌、材料、系列、颜色或备注
zh-CN.inventory.waitingRfidReview: 等待 AMS / RFID 稳定读取
zh-CN.inventory.confirmSkuTitle: 确认自动创建或自动匹配的 SKU 信息正确
zh-CN.inventory.confirmSkuDescription: 请核对这卷耗材的品牌、类型/系列、颜色和克重。信息不正确时先进入 SKU 编辑；确认无误后保存，系统会清除待确认状态。
zh-CN.inventory.historySpoolsSubtitle: 只展示 empty、archived 状态的历史料卷，不计入当前库存。
zh-CN.inventory.searchHistorySpools: 搜索历史料卷、状态、位置、UID 或备注
zh-CN.inventory.noHistorySpools: 暂无已归档或已用尽料卷
zh-CN.inventory.confirmSkuReplacementDescripti: 换料后识别到新耗材。请核对品牌、类型/系列、颜色和克重；信息不正确时先编辑 SKU，确认后会清除待确认状态。
zh-CN.inventory.uidConflictDescription: AMS 读到的 UID 已属于历史用尽或归档料卷。请选择恢复旧料卷、将本次识别登记为新料卷，或忽略本次识别。
zh-CN.inventory.confirmStatus.empty: 确定将料卷 #{id} 标记为用尽吗？它会从当前库存重量中移除，并保留历史记录。
zh-CN.inventory.confirmStatus.archived: 确定归档料卷 #{id} 吗？它会从当前库存中移除，并保留历史记录。
zh-CN.inventory.confirmStatus.opened_in_storag: 确定将料卷 #{id} 恢复为开封库存吗？
zh-CN.inventory.statusUpdated.opened_in_storag: 料卷已恢复为开封库存
zh-CN.inventory.uidConflictConfirm.restore_old: 确定恢复历史料卷并绑定到当前 AMS 槽位吗？
zh-CN.inventory.uidConflictConfirm.create_new: 确定将本次识别创建为新料卷吗？历史料卷会保留，但 UID 会转移到新料卷。
zh-CN.inventory.uidConflictConfirm.ignore: 确定忽略本次 UID 识别吗？
zh-CN.inventory.deleteBrandConfirm: 确定删除品牌 #{id} 吗？如果仍有关联类型/系列或颜色映射，系统会阻止删除。
zh-CN.inventory.deleteTypeSeriesConfirm: 确定删除类型/系列 #{id} 吗？如果仍有关联 SKU 或料卷，系统会阻止删除。
zh-CN.inventory.deleteSkuConfirm: 确定删除 SKU #{id} 吗？如果已有真实料卷引用该 SKU，系统会阻止删除。
zh-CN.inventory.forceDeleteSkuConfirm: SKU #{id} 还有 {quantity} 卷未开封库存。强制删除会同时丢弃这条 SKU 的未开封数量；如果这是真实库存，请先保留或调整。确认强制删除？
zh-CN.inventory.remainingWeightRequired: 请填写剩余重量，或填写剩余百分比并确保 SKU 有标称净重。
zh-CN.export.title: 本地导出
zh-CN.export.backupHint: JSON 是可导入的完整备份，CSV ZIP 仅用于查看和分析。备份会包含打印机连接信息，请妥善保存。
zh-CN.export.importHint: 仅支持导入 JSON 备份。清空后恢复会删除当前数据库中的可恢复数据，再写入备份内容。
zh-CN.export.importReplaceConfirm: 清空后恢复会删除当前系统中的打印机、耗材、AMS、日志、事件和通知等可恢复数据。确定继续？
zh-CN.events.title: 事件中心
zh-CN.events.filamentSkuReviewPending: 料卷 #{spool} 在 {slot} 等待 SKU 信息核对
zh-CN.events.spoolUnidentified: {slot} 暂未读到可用料卷身份，等待 AMS/RFID 稳定上报
zh-CN.events.slotIdentityFallback: {slot} 官方 UID 无效，临时使用标签 UID 识别
zh-CN.events.spoolLocationUpdated: 耗材所在槽位记录已更新
zh-CN.events.inventoryLoadedToAms: 料卷 #{spool} 已记录为装入 {slot}
zh-CN.events.inventoryUnloadedFromAms: 料卷 #{spool} 已从 {slot} 移出
zh-CN.events.inventoryOpenedFromStock: 料卷 #{spool} 已从未开封库存开封
zh-CN.events.inventorySealedAdjusted: 未开封库存数量已调整
zh-CN.events.inventoryWeightUpdated: 料卷 #{spool} 剩余量已更新
zh-CN.events.inventoryNeedsLocation: 料卷 #{spool} 需要设置存储位置
zh-CN.events.inventorySkuConfirmed: 料卷 #{spool} 的 SKU 已确认
zh-CN.events.realtimeDisconnected: 实时连接已断开，已降级为 10 秒轮询。
zh-CN.printers.deleteConfirm: 确定删除“{name}”的本地打印机配置吗？这会断开本地 MQTT 连接，但不会向打印机发送控制命令。
zh-CN.debug.experimentalHint: 延迟摄影、维护、打印日志和通知仍属于实验性功能，尚未完美运行。请根据自己的使用需求决定是否打开。
zh-CN.debug.experimentalTimelapseHint: 读取打印机媒体目录并展示延迟摄影，部分机型或存储状态下可能不完整。
zh-CN.debug.experimentalMaintenanceHint: 基于本地规则和打印时长估算维护提醒，可能与设备实际维护要求不完全一致。
zh-CN.debug.experimentalPrintLogHint: 根据 MQTT 遥测推导打印记录，异常断连或重启时可能存在遗漏。
zh-CN.debug.experimentalNotificationsHint: 本地发送 Webhook / ntfy 通知，规则匹配、静默时间和外部服务可用性仍需观察。
zh-CN.scan.phaseVerify: 正在验证 Bambu 设备信息
zh-CN.error.fullRefreshNotConnected: 打印机未连接。完整刷新需要先连接 MQTT；当前已刷新本地缓存的大屏数据。
zh-CN.form.name: 名称
zh-CN.table.name: 名称
zh-CN.fields.aux_part_fan: 辅助部件风扇开关状态
zh-CN.fields.modeCur: 当前风道 / 仓温模式
zh-CN.fields.modeCur_name: 当前风道 / 仓温模式
zh-CN.fields.name: 名称
zh-CN.fields.tray_reading_bits: 槽位 RFID 读取位图
zh-CN.values.set_airduct: 调整风道 / 仓温模式

en-US.app.name: FilamentManager
en-US.app.subtitle: Local Printer Ops
en-US.overview.title: Printer Overview
en-US.overview.subtitle: Connection, print state, alerts, temperatures, and data coverage are surfaced first; open a printer dashboard, metrics, or asset page from here.
en-US.overview.noPrintersHint: Add or scan for Bambu printers on your LAN.
en-US.overview.search: Search name, host, model, or state
en-US.dashboard.cameraStreamLanLiveviewRequire: Enable LAN live view on the printer
en-US.metrics.temperatureSubtitle: Nozzle, bed, and chamber temperature over time
en-US.metrics.wifiSubtitle: Signal strength in dBm; closer to 0 is stronger
en-US.storage.previewSubtitle: {count} videos. Previews seek to the final frame to show the finished model.
en-US.maintenance.subtitle: Track local maintenance by print hours and keep due items visible.
en-US.maintenance.worklistSubtitle: Due items are grouped first; marking done only records local history.
en-US.inventory.searchSku: Search SKU, brand, material, series, color, or note
en-US.inventory.confirmSkuTitle: Confirm the auto-created or auto-matched SKU is correct
en-US.inventory.confirmSkuDescription: Review brand, type / series, color, and weight for this spool. Edit the SKU first if anything is wrong; confirm when it is correct to clear the pending state.
en-US.inventory.historySpoolsSubtitle: Shows only empty and archived historical spools. These are excluded from current stock.
en-US.inventory.searchHistorySpools: Search historical spools, status, location, UID, or note
en-US.inventory.waitingRfidReview: Waiting for stable AMS / RFID read
en-US.inventory.confirmSkuReplacementDescripti: A new filament was detected after filament change. Review brand, type / series, color, and weight; edit the SKU first if needed, then confirm to clear the pending state.
en-US.inventory.uidConflictDescription: AMS read a UID that already belongs to an empty or archived spool. Restore the old spool, create a new spool for this read, or ignore this recognition.
en-US.inventory.confirmStatus.empty: Mark spool #{id} as empty? It will be removed from current stock weight while history is kept.
en-US.inventory.confirmStatus.archived: Archive spool #{id}? It will be removed from current stock while history is kept.
en-US.inventory.uidConflictConfirm.restore_old: Restore the historical spool and bind it to the current AMS slot?
en-US.inventory.uidConflictConfirm.create_new: Create a new spool for this recognition? The historical spool stays archived, but the UID moves to the new spool.
en-US.inventory.deleteBrandConfirm: Delete brand #{id}? The system will block deletion if type / series or color mappings still reference it.
en-US.inventory.deleteTypeSeriesConfirm: Delete type / series #{id}? The system will block deletion if SKUs or spools still reference it.
en-US.inventory.deleteSkuConfirm: Delete SKU #{id}? The system will block deletion if real spools still reference it.
en-US.inventory.forceDeleteSkuConfirm: SKU #{id} still has {quantity} sealed stock. Force delete will discard this SKU's sealed quantity; keep or adjust it first if this is real stock. Force delete?
en-US.inventory.remainingWeightRequired: Enter remaining weight, or enter remaining percent and make sure the SKU has a nominal weight.
en-US.export.title: Local Export
en-US.export.backupHint: JSON is a restorable full backup. CSV ZIP is for viewing and analysis only. Backups include printer connection details; store them carefully.
en-US.export.importHint: Only JSON backups can be imported. Replace mode deletes restorable local data before writing the backup.
en-US.export.importReplaceConfirm: Replace mode deletes current restorable printers, filament, AMS, logs, events, and notifications before importing. Continue?
en-US.events.title: Event Center
en-US.events.filamentSkuReviewPending: Spool #{spool} at {slot} is waiting for SKU review
en-US.events.spoolUnidentified: {slot} has no stable spool identity yet; waiting for AMS/RFID data
en-US.events.slotIdentityFallback: {slot} has invalid official UID; temporarily using tag UID
en-US.events.inventoryLoadedToAms: Spool #{spool} was recorded as loaded to {slot}
en-US.events.inventoryOpenedFromStock: Spool #{spool} was opened from sealed stock
en-US.events.realtimeDisconnected: Realtime connection is disconnected; falling back to 10-second polling.
en-US.printers.deleteConfirm: Delete local printer config for "{name}"? This disconnects the local MQTT session but does not send control commands to the printer.
en-US.debug.experimentalHint: Timelapse, Maintenance, Print Log, and Notifications are experimental and are not fully polished yet. Decide whether to enable them based on your own needs.
en-US.debug.experimentalTimelapseHint: Reads printer media directories and shows timelapse videos. Some models or storage states may be incomplete.
en-US.debug.experimentalMaintenanceHint: Estimates maintenance reminders from local rules and print hours, which may not fully match the printer's actual maintenance needs.
en-US.debug.experimentalPrintLogHint: Derives print history from MQTT telemetry. Disconnects or restarts may leave gaps.
en-US.debug.experimentalNotificationsHint: Sends local Webhook / ntfy notifications. Rule matching, quiet hours, and external service availability still need observation.
en-US.error.fullRefreshNotConnected: Printer is not connected. Full refresh requires MQTT connection; cached dashboard data has been refreshed.
en-US.form.name: Name
en-US.table.name: Name
en-US.fields.name: Name
